pay.comeBackAndTapI: Come back and tap I've sent it, with the reference number if you have it.
pay.thisSendsRealMoneyThrough: This sends real money through Xendit and can't be undone here. The exact amount is worked out when it sends, after any approved vale.
pay.eGHandedOverIn: e.g. handed over in an envelope, with receipt
pay.xenditCouldnTConfirmIt: Xendit couldn't confirm it, so it's held for review. Check Xendit before trying again.
pay.sendFromOwn: {period}. You send it from your own {wallet}; Linara keeps the record and asks {name} to confirm it arrived.
pay.noWalletYet: There's no {wallet} number for {name} yet. Ask {name} to add one in the Linara app (My Pay, then {whereToSend}), or record a cash or bank payment with {paidOutside}.
pay.numberFromInvite: This number is from {name}'s invite and isn't confirmed in their app yet, so check it with them before you send.
pay.scanFromAnother: Or scan the QR from another phone. On this phone, {openIt}, save it, and upload it in {wallet}'s QR scanner.
pay.openAndSend: Open {wallet} and send {amount} to the number above.
pay.checkName: Check that {wallet} shows the name above before you confirm.
pay.forItGoesOnBoth: {periodLabel} · {span} for {helperName}. It goes on both your records, and {helperName2} is asked in the Linara app to confirm it arrived.
pay.theseCutoffsClosed: These cutoffs closed with no payment on record, oldest first. Pay them now, or record how they were paid outside Linara.
pay.valeStillOwedSuffix: The {amount} of vale still owed comes off whichever payment goes first.
pay.twelfthOfBasicPay: A twelfth of the {basic} basic pay paid for work since {since}. No contributions or vale come out of it.
pay.paidThisCutoffSummary: {paidCount} of {totalCount} paid this cutoff · {totalAmount} for everyone
